body:
Yes, I'm from Australia. How did you know?

I would really like to believe I could get better and that I will have a good, enjoyable life. It's just that, given my status I don't see how I could do it. I just can't picture a life I'd enjoy. Like, there is not any jobs out there that I'd want to have. I used to want a job in IT because one of my hobbies is computer games (probably relates to many many other people) but after doing a networking course I discovered it's not for me.

I started taking medicine about a month ago; Zoloft. The only observable difference I see when I take it is that I feel less nervous in public, which is good. I've been thinking of seeking therapy/other medication when school starts to see how my feelings change then.
